analysis.investment_thesis: Active Infra fails the Magic Formula on both dimensions: earnings yield of ~7.3% (EBIT 24 / EV ~327) is below my 12% threshold, and ROCE of 15.5% falls short of the 20%+ required for "good business." A civil construction micro-cap at 26x P/E with single-digit crore profits is neither cheap nor high-quality enough.
key_strengths: Revenue scaling fast (1→90 Cr) with margins expanding (EBITDA 28 Cr in 2025)
Debt reduced from 109 Cr (2022) to 60 Cr (2025); equity infusion strengthened balance sheet
Promoter holding high at 72.38%, aligned skin-in-the-game
key_risks: Earnings yield ~7.3% — not cheap for a cyclical construction micro-cap
ROCE 15.5% is mediocre; construction is capital-intensive with lumpy working capital
FCF collapsed from 11 Cr (2023) to 2 Cr (2025) despite rising profits — working capital sink
red_flags: OCF fell to 5 Cr in 2025 vs PAT of 13 Cr — earnings quality deteriorating
Total assets doubled (108→220 Cr) funded by equity raise, diluting ROE durability
Only 3 years of meaningful operating history — ROIC sustainability unproven
analysis.detailed_analysis:
Running the Magic Formula: EBIT of ~24 Cr against an enterprise value of roughly 327 Cr (MCap 267 + Debt 60) yields an earnings yield near 7.3% — well short of the 12% threshold I consider attractive. Return on capital, proxied by the stated ROCE of 15.5%, is similarly mediocre against my 20%+ bar. A stock that is neither cheap nor a demonstrably high-return business does not make the cut — and civil construction is a notoriously capital-intensive, working-capital-hungry, cyclically exposed industry where one-off project wins can distort a single year's numbers.

The 2025 equity raise (reserves jumped from 22→108 Cr) inflated the asset base and will drag future ROE/ROCE unless deployed at high returns. More concerning is cash conversion: operating cash flow fell to 5 Cr against a 13 Cr PAT, and FCF is barely positive at 2 Cr. On the Magic Formula's unemotional ranking, Active Infra would sit in the bottom half of the screen — pass.
